3. import { createCesiumComponent, PickCesiumProps, Merge, ConstructorOptions2 } from "../core";
4. 
5. /*
6. @summary
7. `ImageryLayer` is a imargery layer on the globe.
8. 
9. Layers are added in order of JSX from the top.
10. 
11. ```jsx
12. // Back layer
13. <ImageryLayer imageryProvider={provider1} />
14. <ImageryLayer imageryProvider={provider2} />
15. <ImageryLayer imageryProvider={provider3} />
16. // Front layer
17. ```
18. 
19. is equivalent to:
20. 
21. ```js
22. viewer.imageryLayers.add(provider1);
23. viewer.imageryLayers.add(provider2);
24. viewer.imageryLayers.add(provider3);
25. ```
26. 
27. As a result, the layer added at the very end is the frontmost when actually displayed.
28. 
29. Note: `imageryProvider` property is read only. See also [guide](/guide#cesium-read-only-properties).
30. */
31. 
32. /*
33. @scope
34. Either:
35. - Inside [Viewer](/components/Viewer) or [CesiumWidget](/components/CesiumWidget) component: the imargery layer will be attached to the ImageryLayerCollection of the Viewer or CesiumWidget.
36. - Inside [ImageryLayerCollection](/components/ImageryLayerCollection) component: same as above

data.content:
Implemented the Cesium **1.103.0 → 1.107.0** upgrade end-to-end.

Updated the manifest/lockfile and adapted Resium to Cesium 1.107 API changes: async `Model.fromGltfAsync` / `Cesium3DTileset.fromUrl`, removed `readyPromise` usage in favor of readiness events/polling, mapped legacy `imageryProvider` props to the new `baseLayer` API, added support for new terrain/base-layer options, and adjusted examples/stories for renamed async Cesium helpers. Also added a Vitest Cesium alias to avoid the split-package ESM export issue in Cesium 1.107.
